name: Live Matches
description: Sports channels: Streamed.pk, PPV.to, and CDN Live with polished settings UI and catalog artwork.
overview: Provider folders for live schedules, PPV categories, and CDN channels/sports. Settings group toggles, playback, and API URLs; package includes plugin icon for the dashboard.

versions.changelog: Polished settings page (sections and help text), channel primary image for Jellyfin UI, meta imagePath + zip packaging, friendlier folder descriptions.
Live playback: browser Referer/User-Agent for ffmpeg, longer HLS probe, disable HLS direct-play (remux/transcode), richer embed URL extraction.
Fix channel playback: MediaSource Id now matches Jellyfin item id (fixes empty playback / wrong screen).
Catalog release: Streamed.pk, PPV.to, CDN Live; Jellyfin plugin repository support.
